simple.prompt: Our development team ___ the client's headquarters in Tokyo yesterday.
simple.explanation: Keterangan waktu lampau selesai 'yesterday' menandakan Past Simple. Verb beraturan 'visit' ditambah -ed menjadi 'visited'.

simple.prompt: She ___ a comprehensive report about the market trends last week.
simple.explanation: Irregular verb bentuk lampau (V2) dari 'write' adalah 'wrote'.
hints: Bentuk V2 dari write adalah wrote.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Past Simple positif dengan irregular verb.
simple.targetSentence: They bought a new server yesterday.
simple.explanation: Subject (They) + V2 (bought) + Object (a new server) + Time (yesterday).
hints: Bentuk lampau dari buy adalah bought.

simple.prompt: The flight was delayed, so we ___ in London until midnight.
simple.explanation: Pola kalimat negatif Past Simple adalah 'didn't' + kata kerja dasar murni (bare infinitive): 'didn't arrive'.
hints: Setelah auxiliary 'didn't', verb kembali ke bentuk dasar V1.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya Past Simple dengan auxiliary 'Did'.
simple.targetSentence: Did you receive my email this morning?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan: Did + Subject (you) + Verb dasar (receive) + Object + Time?
hints: Gunakan kata kerja dasar 'receive' setelah subjek.

simple.prompt: He ___ thirty minutes ago to confirm his flight reservation.
simple.explanation: Frasa '... ago' (thirty minutes ago) adalah penanda waktu lampau spesifik yang mewajibkan Past Simple: 'called'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat negatif Past Simple dengan keterangan waktu 'last night'.
simple.targetSentence: She didn't finish the slides last night.
simple.explanation: Subject (She) + didn't + base verb (finish) + Object (the slides) + Time (last night).

simple.prompt: Our design team ___ the prototype yesterday afternoon.
simple.explanation: 'Yesterday afternoon' menandai waktu lampau selesai, gunakan V2 'finished'.
hints: Kata kerja beraturan lampau memakai akhiran -ed.

simple.prompt: She ___ her old laptop to a junior colleague last month.
simple.explanation: 'Last month' menunjukkan kejadian lampau selesai; V2 tidak beraturan dari 'give' adalah 'gave'.

simple.prompt: They ___ stay late at the warehouse on Friday.
simple.explanation: Kalimat negatif Past Simple dengan verb aksi 'stay' memakai auxiliary 'didn't' + base verb.

simple.prompt: Did the technician ___ the damaged cable this morning?
simple.explanation: Setelah auxiliary 'Did' dalam kalimat tanya, verb kembali ke bentuk dasar: 'replace'.
hints: Sudah ada kata bantu lampau 'Did' di awal.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan singkat tentang perjalanan akhir pekan.
dialogue: We visited the botanical gardens in Bogor.
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan Past Simple dengan main verb 'go' membutuhkan auxiliary 'did'.
hints: Lihat verb utama 'go' dan jawaban V2 'visited'.

simple.prompt: The train ___ right on time despite the morning drizzle.
simple.explanation: Kejadian lampau beraturan memakai V2 'arrived' (hanya tambah -d karena berakhiran -e).

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan ganda Past Simple pada kalimat berikut.
simple.draft: Did you saw the revised schedule I emailed last night?
options: Did you see the revised schedule I emailed last night?
Did you seen the revised schedule I emailed last night?
Was you see the revised schedule I emailed last night?
simple.explanation: Setelah auxiliary 'Did', kata kerja tidak beraturan harus kembali ke V1 'see', bukan V2 'saw'.

simple.prompt: Did Nara finish the monthly tax summary? — Yes, she ___.
simple.explanation: Jawaban singkat mengikuti auxiliary pertanyaan ('Did' + 'she') menjadi 'Yes, she did.'

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Past Simple dengan kata kerja tidak beraturan.
simple.targetSentence: We bought three new office chairs last Tuesday.
simple.explanation: V2 dari 'buy' adalah 'bought'; keterangan waktu lampau diletakkan di akhir.

simple.prompt: Susun pertanyaan Past Simple tentang kedatangan paket.
simple.targetSentence: When did the courier deliver the lab equipment?
simple.explanation: Pola pertanyaan: Wh-word (When) + did + Subject + V1 (deliver) + Object?

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog tanya jawab di kantor tentang konfirmasi perjalanan.
dialogue: ___ the regional director attend the opening plenary?
Yes, he did. He delivered the keynote speech.
intermediate.explanation: Pertanyaan Past Simple dengan kata kerja aksi dasar ('attend') menggunakan auxiliary 'Did': 'Did the regional director attend...?'

intermediate.prompt: We ___ any unexpected downtime during last month's system migration.
intermediate.explanation: Negatif Past Simple: did not + base verb 'experience' (tanpa akhiran -d).
hints: Setelah 'did not', gunakan bentuk dasar kata kerja.

intermediate.explanation: Wh-question Past Simple: Wh-word (Where) + auxiliary (did) + subject (you) + base verb (do)?
hints: Perhatikan rumus: Question word + did + Subject + Verb dasar.
Auxiliary 'did' dan main verb 'do' keduanya diperlukan.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan urutan dua peristiwa lampau berurutan.
intermediate.targetSentence: He entered the room and turned on the lights.
intermediate.explanation: Aksi lampau yang terjadi berurutan (sequence of completed actions) keduanya menggunakan V2: entered ... and turned on.
hints: Gunakan kedua V2: entered dan turned on.

intermediate.prompt: Ejaan V2 teratur: The supply chain team ___ the goods directly to the warehouse.
intermediate.explanation: Verb 1 suku kata berakhiran konsonan-vokal-konsonan (s-h-i-p) menggandakan huruf konsonan akhir sebelum -ed: shipped.
hints: Pola 1 suku kata K-V-K pada kata 'ship'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat Past Simple dengan irregular verb 'think/thought'.
intermediate.targetSentence: We thought the presentation went very well.
intermediate.explanation: V2 dari 'think' adalah 'thought', dan V2 dari 'go' adalah 'went'.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih jawaban singkat Past Simple yang tepat.
dialogue: Did the finance team detect any discrepancies in the ledger?
intermediate.explanation: Jawaban singkat negatif Past Simple: 'No, they didn't.'

intermediate.prompt: First, Rita logged into the portal; next, she ___ the PDF invoices.
intermediate.explanation: Rangkaian peristiwa berurutan di masa lampau semuanya diceritakan dengan Past Simple (V2 'downloaded').
hints: Urutan kejadian lampau memakai Past Simple secara konsisten.

intermediate.prompt: The shipping clerk ___ the heavy parcel carefully onto the wooden pallet.
intermediate.explanation: V2 dari verb transitif 'lay' (meletakkan benda) adalah 'laid' ('lied' berarti berbohong).

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog di meja HR mengenai riwayat kerja masa lalu.
dialogue: How long did you live in Surabaya before moving here?
I ___ there for four years while finishing my degree.
intermediate.explanation: Durasi di masa lalu yang sudah berakhir sempurna ('for four years' dan sekarang sudah pindah) menggunakan Past Simple 'lived'.
hints: Situasi masa lalu sudah selesai dan tidak berlanjut.

intermediate.prompt: The old printer ___ three times yesterday before IT replaced it.
intermediate.explanation: Verb satu suku kata berpola CVC ('jam') menggandakan konsonan akhir sebelum -ed: 'jammed'.
hints: Perhatikan pola huruf vokal-konsonan di akhir 'jam'.

intermediate.prompt: Why ___ nobody answer the emergency hotline after midnight?
intermediate.explanation: Subjek 'nobody' dengan main verb 'answer' dalam pertanyaan lampau tetap memakai auxiliary 'did'.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan bentuk lampau pada kalimat berikut.
intermediate.draft: Yesterday morning, the power went out and all monitors shutted off at once.
options: Yesterday morning, the power went out and all monitors shut off at once.
Yesterday morning, the power gone out and all monitors shut off at once.
Yesterday morning, the power went out and all monitors were shutted off at once.
intermediate.explanation: 'Shut' adalah irregular verb tipe AAA (shut-shut-shut) sehingga V2-nya tetap 'shut', bukan 'shutted'.
hints: Bentuk V1, V2, dan V3 'shut' sama persis.

intermediate.prompt: When he was a trainee, Dani often ___ notes in a pocket notebook.
intermediate.explanation: Kebiasaan berulang di masa lalu yang sudah usai juga dinyatakan dengan Past Simple; 'carry' → 'carried'.
hints: 'When he was a trainee' menunjukkan masa lalu.

intermediate.prompt: Who ___ the keynote presentation at last month's tech forum?
intermediate.explanation: Subject question lampau langsung memakai V2 tanpa 'did'; V2 dari 'lead' adalah 'led' (bukan 'leaded').

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat negatif Past Simple tentang rapat kemarin.
intermediate.targetSentence: The board members didn't approve the risky merger yesterday.
intermediate.explanation: Negatif Past Simple memakai Subject + didn't + V1 (approve).

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat urutan dua tindakan lampau yang beruntun.
intermediate.targetSentence: He locked the archive door and handed the key to security.
intermediate.explanation: Dua aksi lampau berurutan memakai dua V2 paralel ('locked' dan 'handed').
hints: Mulai dengan 'He locked the archive door'.
Sambungkan dengan 'and handed the key to security'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan umum 'double marking' pada bentuk lampau negatif.
complex.draft: The senior engineer didn't noticed the security vulnerability in the source code.
options: The senior engineer didn't notice the security vulnerability in the source code.
The senior engineer didn't noticing the security vulnerability in the source code.
The senior engineer don't noticed the security vulnerability in the source code.
complex.explanation: Kesalahan 'double past': auxiliary 'didn't' sudah menandai bentuk lampau, sehingga kata kerja utama WAJIB kembali ke bentuk dasar 'notice' (bukan noticed).

complex.prompt: Perhatikan perbedaan pasangan irregular verb: 'The bell ___ at 8:00, and the choir ___ beautifully.'
complex.explanation: Bentuk V2 dari 'ring' adalah 'rang', dan V2 dari 'sing' adalah 'sang'. ('Rung' dan 'sung' adalah V3 past participle).
hints: V2 ring = rang; V2 sing = sang.

complex.prompt: Before electricity was common, families ___ around the radio every evening.
complex.explanation: 'Used to + V1' digunakan untuk kebiasaan atau rutinitas masa lalu yang sudah tidak terjadi lagi saat ini (past habitual action).
hints: Menyatakan kebiasaan masa lalu yang sudah berhenti.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat Past Simple dengan inversi kata tanya subjek.
complex.targetSentence: Who authorized the budget expenditure last week?
complex.explanation: Subject question: 'Who' bertindak sebagai subjek, langsung diikuti V2 'authorized' tanpa auxiliary 'did'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kekeliruan antara V2 'lay' (menaruh) dan V2 'lie' (berbaring/terletak).
complex.draft: After the exhausting trek, the explorers layed down on the grass to rest.
options: After the exhausting trek, the explorers lay down on the grass to rest.
After the exhausting trek, the explorers lied down on the grass to rest.
After the exhausting trek, the explorers laid down on the grass to rest.
complex.explanation: Kata kerja intransitif 'lie down' (berbaring) memiliki bentuk V2 yang tidak beraturan: 'lay' (bukan layed). 'Laid' adalah V2 dari kata kerja transitif 'lay' (menaruh benda).
hints: Bentuk V2 dari lie down adalah 'lay down'.

complex.prompt: It is high time we ___ the outdated server infrastructure.
complex.explanation: Setelah struktur subjungtif hipotetis 'It is high time / It is about time + subject', wajib menggunakan bentuk Past Subjunctive (Past Simple V2): 'It is high time we upgraded...'.
hints: Wajib diikuti oleh bentuk Past Simple V2.

dialogue: At what precise moment did the unauthorized intrusion take place?
The logs indicate the breach ___ at precisely 02:14 a.m.
complex.explanation: 'Occur' adalah intransitive verb yang bentuk V2 teraturnya adalah 'occurred' (double r). Kata kerja intransitif tidak dapat dibentuk pasif 'was occurred'.
hints: Kata kerja intransitif 'occur' berbentuk aktif lampau.

complex.prompt: I would rather you ___ the confidential draft before sharing it with vendors.
complex.explanation: Setelah 'would rather + subject lain', bahasa Inggris formal memakai Past Subjunctive (bentuk V2 'reviewed') untuk harapan saat ini/mendatang.
hints: Perhatikan ada subjek lain ('you') setelah 'would rather'.
Konstruksi 'would rather + sb + V2' bermakna saran/harapan.

complex.prompt: It is high time our department ___ its legacy accounting software.
complex.explanation: Ungkapan 'It is (high/about) time + subject' selalu diikuti kata kerja bentuk Past Simple ('upgraded') untuk menyatakan hal yang seharusnya sudah dilakukan.
hints: Pola baku: 'It is high time + S + V2'.
Meskipun konteksnya sekarang, gunakan bentuk lampau.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan bentuk lampau antara 'cost' dan 'spend' dalam laporan anggaran berikut.
complex.draft: Upgrading the ventilation system costed the hospital twice what planners anticipated.
options: Upgrading the ventilation system cost the hospital twice what planners anticipated.
Upgrading the ventilation system costs the hospital twice what planners anticipated.
Upgrading the ventilation system was cost the hospital twice what planners anticipated.
complex.explanation: 'Cost' (berbiaya) memiliki V1=V2=V3 ('cost-cost-cost'); 'costed' tidak baku untuk arti harga/biaya.
hints: Irregular verb 'cost' tidak berubah di bentuk Past Simple.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan akademik mengenai ungkapan penyesalan dengan 'If only'.
dialogue: Our sample size was too small for statistical power.
True. If only we ___ wider demographic data earlier, or had more funding now.
complex.explanation: Dalam klausa 'If only / wish' tentang kondisi yang diharapkan berbeda, gunakan bentuk Past (di sini 'collected' untuk pengandaian masa lampau sederhana/formal atau kontras).
hints: Setelah 'If only', verb digeser mundur ke bentuk Past.

complex.prompt: During his apprenticeship in Kyoto, Master Kenji ___ never rush a single brushstroke.
complex.explanation: Selain Past Simple, 'would' dipakai dalam narasi sastra/biografi formal untuk kebiasaan khas masa lalu yang penuh nuansa nostalgia.
hints: Bukan pertanyaan, melainkan kebiasaan rutin di masa lampau.
Modal 'would' + base verb 'rush' menyatakan kebiasaan masa lalu.

complex.prompt: Suppose the client ___ to sign the addendum tomorrow — what is our fallback plan?
complex.explanation: Setelah 'Suppose / Supposing' dalam skenario hipotetis, Past Simple ('refused') menandakan kondisi pengandaian yang dianggap kecil kemungkinannya.
hints: Bentuk V2 melemahkan kemungkinan secara pragmatis.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan verb tidak beraturan 'seek' vs 'seeked' pada kalimat sejarah industri berikut.
complex.draft: Early engineers seeked a corrosion-resistant alloy for deep-sea pipelines.
options: Early engineers sought a corrosion-resistant alloy for deep-sea pipelines.
Early engineers soughted a corrosion-resistant alloy for deep-sea pipelines.
Early engineers seeks a corrosion-resistant alloy for deep-sea pipelines.
complex.explanation: Bentuk Past Simple (V2) dan Past Participle (V3) dari 'seek' adalah 'sought', bukan 'seeked'.

complex.prompt: Not until the auditor inspected the ledger ___ the discrepancy emerge.
complex.explanation: Inversi negatif 'Not until [clause]...' memicu inversi Past Simple pada klausa utama: auxiliary 'did' sebelum subjek 'the discrepancy' + V1 'emerge'.
hints: Perhatikan verb dasar 'emerge' di akhir kalimat.
Inversi Past Simple memakai 'did + S + V1'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat formal memakai konstruksi 'It is about time'.
complex.targetSentence: It is about time the team standardized its documentation.
complex.explanation: 'It is about time + Subject + V2' menekankan bahwa standardisasi sudah mendesak dilakukan.
hints: Awali dengan 'It is about time the team'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat menggunakan inversi formal dengan 'Only yesterday'.
complex.targetSentence: Only yesterday did the vendor confirm the final shipping date.
complex.explanation: 'Only yesterday' di awal kalimat memicu inversi Past Simple: 'did + the vendor + confirm'.
